Sandbox_PZMCompanion_SharePositions: Show other players on the web map
Sandbox_PZMCompanion_SharePositions_tool: Sends everyone's position to the players you choose, so friends can see each other on projectzomboidmap.com. Off: nobody. Faction members only: each player sees their own faction. Everyone: all players on this server see each other.
Sandbox_PZMCompanion_ShareInterval_toolt: How often the server sends player positions. 1 is smooth; raise it on servers with many players to save bandwidth.
